fact: Niger's third national statistics development strategy, SNDS 2022-2026, was finalised in May 2022 after an evaluation of SNDS 2017-2021 that found a 66.6 percent physical execution rate, with a mid-term evaluation planned for 2024 and a final one for 2026.
title: Troisième Stratégie Nationale de Développement de la Statistique (SNDS) 2022-2026
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Niger (Ministère du Plan)
